verdict_reason: Template-mismatch hypothesis NOT confirmed. Switching adapter base from non-Instruct to Instruct (matching what adapter_config.json declares) only marginally reduces degradation magnitude: HellaSwag goes from -1.2pp to +0.4pp (within noise both times), MMLU from -4.95pp to -3.19pp (35.6% shrink — partial), TriviaQA from -9.4pp to -8.2pp (only 12.8% shrink — persisted). 2/3 benchmarks classify as PERSISTED (shrink < 50%, |Delta| within 25% of BG-Rho); 1/3 SHRUNK. Decision rule: 2/3 persisted + 0 shrunk-2/3 -> FORGETTING_INDEPENDENT. The catastrophic-forgetting signature on factual recall (TriviaQA) is robust to base choice; this is direct evidence that the LoRA adapter degrades the underlying capability of Llama-3.2-3B regardless of which sibling base it composes onto.

delta_difference_pp.interpretation: All 3 benches: |Delta_Instruct| < |Delta_Rho| (degradation reduced under matching anchor) but the reduction is small (1.2-1.8pp on a per-bench scale where TriviaQA degradation is 8-9pp). The template-mismatch component contributes ~12-36% of observed BG-Rho degradation; the remainder (~64-88%) is base-independent forgetting.

hellaswag.interpretation: Within-noise: |0.4| < 4.31; HellaSwag MC accuracy NOT statistically distinguishable between LoRA and Instruct base

mmlu.interpretation: Statistically significant degradation: |3.19| >> 0.86; LoRA causes 3.19pp drop in 5-shot MMLU on Instruct base

triviaqa.interpretation: Statistically significant degradation: |8.2| >> 4.47; LoRA causes 8.2pp drop in 0-shot TriviaQA EM on Instruct base

f1_v3_v2_caveat: SUCCESS technically passes c3+c4 (2/3 + 3/3) but direction of c3 deltas remains negative on MMLU + TriviaQA — same INFRASTRUCTURE_PASS / SCIENCE_FAIL hybrid as BG-Rho. The framework detects significant LoRA-vs-base separation; the separation is in the WRONG direction (degradation, not improvement). Net effect of switching to Instruct anchor: slightly less severe degradation but qualitatively unchanged finding.

hypothesis_classification.decision_rule: >=2/3 shrunk(>=50%) -> TEMPLATE_MISMATCH_CONFIRMED; any increased(>+25%) -> UNEXPECTED; >=2/3 persisted -> FORGETTING_INDEPENDENT

instruct_base_vs_non_instruct_base_delta.comment: Instruct base anchors are HIGHER than non-Instruct base anchors on all 3 benchmarks (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct >> Llama-3.2-3B). Non-Instruct anchors from BG-Omicron 93bef8c8: HellaSwag 0.654 acc_norm, MMLU 0.5796, TriviaQA 0.396 EM. Instruct anchors here: HellaSwag 0.632 acc_norm (-2.2pp), MMLU 0.6179 (+3.83pp), TriviaQA 0.480 EM (+8.4pp). MMLU+TriviaQA lift on Instruct is the typical instruction-tuning effect; HellaSwag tiny dip is within noise (stderr 2.16pp).
instruct_base_vs_non_instruct_base_delta.implication_for_lora_eval: Because Instruct base scores HIGHER on MMLU+TriviaQA, the LoRA's ABSOLUTE accuracy on Instruct (MMLU 0.586, TriviaQA 0.398) is roughly comparable to LoRA's absolute accuracy on non-Instruct base from BG-Rho (MMLU 0.530, TriviaQA 0.302). The LoRA adds substantially to the non-Instruct base (which has lower ceiling) but cannot overcome catastrophic forgetting on Instruct (which has higher ceiling).

honest_c3: Anchor is step-8000 LoRA (HF commit 5a9b4584) — same step-pin as BG-Rho. The 2000 lost training steps caveat applies symmetrically: any step-10k recovery would shift both BG-Rho and BG-Psi deltas in correlated fashion. The relative delta_difference between Instruct and non-Instruct base anchors is what tests the template-mismatch hypothesis and this is invariant to step-10k vs step-8k.

Instruct base eval here uses NO chat-template wrapping — lm-eval defaults for hellaswag/mmlu/triviaqa are plain prompts, no <|begin_of_text|> or system/user role tags. Instruct base may UNDERPERFORM its true ceiling without explicit chat-template framing. So 'Instruct base anchors' here are 'raw-prompt-on-Instruct' — comparable to BG-Rho's 'raw-prompt-on-non-Instruct' but NOT to Instruct's chat-templated ceiling. A future BG could re-run with apply_chat_template=true to test if degradation magnitude changes further.

limit=500 single-seed: same statistical caveat as BG-Rho. delta_difference precision ~3pp on hellaswag/triviaqa, ~0.6pp on MMLU. The 1.2-1.8pp delta_differences observed are within 1 stderr on hellaswag and triviaqa, so the 'partial template-mismatch contribution' interpretation should be qualified — single-seed bootstrap CIs would tighten this materially.

Adapter base now matches eval base (Instruct=Instruct), so template-mismatch artifact is removed at the architectural level. The persistence of MMLU+TriviaQA degradation under matching anchor is direct evidence that the LoRA did not preserve base capabilities ⇒ catastrophic forgetting independent of base choice. This is the decisive finding.
